title: FORGETFUL BUT FAITHFUL: A COGNITIVE MEMORY ARCHITECTURE AND BENCHMARK FOR PRIVACY-AWARE GENERATIVE AGENTS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark (FiFA) measures narrative coherence, goal completion, social recall, privacy preservation, and cost efficiency in memory-constrained generative agents.
models_tested: Not specified; the paper refers to 'a particular family of large language models' but does not name them.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
